relevance_note: This 10-patient transplant cohort includes one individually described adult with HA20 (Table 1 row '| 9 | F | 23 | IEI HA20 |', Table S1 'TNFAIP3 (NM_001270508.2):p.Tyr306*'); the other nine patients have other inborn errors of immunity and are out of scope.
method_note: Read the whole paper including the converted supplement (Table S1, Table S2, Fig. S1/S2 legends). Only patient #9 ('IEI HA20') has a TNFAIP3 variant or HA20 diagnosis; patients #1-#8 and #10 (CTLA4HI, APDS, DOCK8, ALPS, DADA2, VEXAS, CVID2) are out of scope and counted only in cohort_size_as_stated (10). No relatives are described. Label '#9' is the paper's own form ('#' column in Tables 1, 2 and S1; '#9' in the text). Tables 1 and 2 have patients as rows; spans quote the row from the '#' cell. Table 1 columns: #, Sex, Age, Diagnosis, CMV, EBV, Donor type, Immune therapy at SCT, IDDA baseline, Karnofsky, HCT-CI, Key clinical features. Table 1 'Age' (23) is age at allo-HSCT (the column values average to the stated 'Mean age at allo-HSCT was 32.1'), so it was not recorded as onset, diagnosis or last-evaluation age; age at last evaluation is not stated (follow-up 17 months after SCT, Table 2). Vital status 'alive' rests on the statements that the only death was patient #6 ('One patient ... died from COVID-19. All remaining 9 patients ...'; Table 2 marks only #6 with the death symbol). Variant: Table S1 prints only a protein description without a cDNA ('TNFAIP3 (NM_001270508.2):p.Tyr306*'); no zygosity, inheritance, parental testing, variant class or functional data are given for it. is_proband and cites_prior_report_of_same_patients left null (not stated). Scores (IDDA 92 baseline, 24 at 1 year; Karnofsky 40; HCT-CI 1) and CMV/EBV serostatus (Pos/Pos) were not recorded as phenotypic features. 'Refractory colitis' mapped to the checklist item 'gastrointestinal ulcers or inflammation'; 'auto-inflammation' maps to no checklist item. Transplant-outcome absences: severe GvHD is stated for #7 and #9 by name; chronic GvHD, EBV reactivation after the depleted graft and late severe infections are whole-cohort statements (all ten patients, with #6 named as the only exception for infections) and are marked 'inferred from group statement'. Unnamed counts (e.g. 4/10 aGvHD grade 2-4, CMV reactivation 50%, 9/10 immunoglobulin replacement before HSCT, 6 patients on immunosuppression for autoimmunity) were not attributed to #9. The JSON was built by a short Python script in the scratch directory that pulls each span as an exact substring of the paper; every value was chosen by reading. Contradictions in the paper (none concern #9 directly): abstract says '5 patients developed grade 2–4 acute GvHD' but Results say 'Four patients developed aGvHD of grade 2–4'; Results say 'Patients #5 and #8 showed mixed chimerism' but Discussion says 'Patients #5 and #6 showed mixed chimerism'.

first_author.span: Authors: de Winter Janneke J. H.

study_type.span: This retrospective analysis included all adult patients with inborn errors of immunity (IEI)

cohort_size_as_stated.span: Ten patients with a variety of IEI were included in this study

span: One patient with GvHD died from COVID-19. All remaining 9 patients were successfully tapered off immunosuppression

treatment_summary.value: Prednisolone + ruxolitinib + anakinra at the time of SCT; alphabetaTCR/CD19-depleted allo-HSCT from a 9/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD 9/10) after ATG and myeloablative conditioning (thiotepa, melphalan, fludarabine); after SCT MMF + prednisolone + ruxolitinib + anakinra, with disease-associated immunosuppression tapered only after MMF was stopped at day 28; letermovir prophylaxis until day 100; no prophylactic DLI because of active transplant-associated immunosuppression.
